paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭho.meaning_2: meaning of the requisites of awakening; significance of the factors of enlightenment
paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭho.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Accusative singular in the text. Compounded from attha, with the double ṭṭha and the -iya- of the middle member.

paṭijotanaṭṭho.meaning_2: state of illuminating separately; state of shining in regard to what is particular
paṭijotanaṭṭho.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Compound of paṭi + jotana (from √jut) + aṭṭha (state, condition) = 'meaning of illuminating separately'. Nom. sg. in the text.

āyāsanā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] In the text it is part of the compound list āyāso upāyāso āyāsanā upāyāsanā āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ, where it functions as an abstract noun of state. The PEU entry suggests āyāsana, but the text reads āyāsanā, so the headword here is the form as it appears. Feminine ā-stem.
āyāsanā.example_1: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa, aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsanā upāyāsanā āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ—
āyāsanā.example_2: Ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, aññataraññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa, aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsanā upāyāsanā āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati upāyāso.
āyāsanā.translation_2: The desponding, despairing, state of despondency, and state of despair of one who has encountered loss of relatives, loss of wealth, loss of health, loss of virtue, or loss of view, or who is affected by some painful phenomenon or other—this is called despair.

nesatīti.meaning_2: does not seek; does not pursue; does not go after
nesatīti.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Negative of neti/nayati with the causal sign -e-; na is fused as n- before the vowel. In the text it forms part of the definition visamaṃ nesatīti samādhi ("because it does not seek the uneven"). Alternative analysis as na + esati (√es, "does not seek") is possible but less likely.
nesatīti.example_1: pariggahaṭṭhena samādhi, parivāraṭṭhena samādhi, paripūraṭṭhena samādhi, ekaggaṭṭhena samādhi, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhi, avisāraṭṭhena samādhi, anāvilaṭṭhena samādhi, aniñjanaṭṭhena samādhi, vimuttaṭṭhena samādhi, ekattupaṭṭhānavasena cittassa ṭhitattā samādhi, samaṃ esatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nesatīti samādhi, samaṃ esitattā samādhi, visamaṃ nesitattā samādhi, samaṃ ādiyatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nādiyatīti samādhi, samaṃ ādinnattā samādhi, visamaṃ anādinnattā samādhi, samaṃ paṭipajjatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nappaṭipajjatīti samādhi, samaṃ paṭipannattā samādhi, visamaṃ nappaṭipannattā samādhi, samaṃ jhāyatīti samādhi, visamaṃ jhāpetīti samādhi, samaṃ jhātattā samādhi, visamaṃ jhāpitattā samādhi, samo ca hito ca sukho cāti samādhi.
nesatīti.example_2: 44. Api ca, pañcavīsati samādhissa samādhiṭṭhā – pariggahaṭṭhena samādhi, parivāraṭṭhena samādhi, paripūraṭṭhena samādhi, ekaggaṭṭhena samādhi, avikkhepaṭṭhena samādhi, avisāraṭṭhena samādhi, anāvilaṭṭhena samādhi, aniñjanaṭṭhena samādhi, vimuttaṭṭhena samādhi, ekattupaṭṭhānavasena cittassa ṭhitattā samādhi, samaṃ esatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nesatīti samādhi, samaṃ esitattā samādhi, visamaṃ nesitattā samādhi, samaṃ ādiyatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nādiyatīti samādhi, samaṃ ādinnattā samādhi, visamaṃ anādinnattā samādhi, samaṃ paṭipajjatīti samādhi, visamaṃ nappaṭipajjatīti samādhi, samaṃ paṭipannattā samādhi, visamaṃ nappaṭipannattā samādhi, samaṃ jhāyatīti samādhi, visamaṃ jhāpetīti samādhi, samaṃ jhātattā samādhi, visamaṃ jhāpitattā samādhi, samo ca hito ca sukho cāti samādhi.
nesatīti.translation_2: 44. Furthermore, there are twenty-five meanings of concentration: concentration in the sense of embracing, concentration in the sense of equipment, concentration in the sense of fulfillment, concentration in the sense of unification, concentration in the sense of non-distraction, concentration in the sense of non-dissipation, concentration in the sense of non-commotion, concentration in the sense of non-perturbation, concentration in the sense of liberation, concentration owing to the steadiness of the mind through establishment in unity, concentration since it seeks sameness, concentration since it does not seek unsameness, concentration owing to sameness being sought, concentration owing to unsameness not being sought, concentration since it grasps sameness, concentration since it does not grasp unsameness, concentration owing to sameness being grasped, concentration owing to unsameness not being grasped, concentration since it enters upon sameness, concentration since it does not enter upon unsameness, concentration owing to sameness being entered upon, concentration owing to unsameness not being entered upon, concentration since sameness is lighted, concentration since it consumes unsameness, concentration owing to sameness being ignited, concentration owing to unsameness being consumed, concentration since it is sameness, welfare, and pleasure.

abhibhuyyitvā.meaning_2: having overcome; having overpowered; having transcended
abhibhuyyitvā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Absolutive in -itvā of abhibhavati with the passive/denominative -yya- (cf. abhibhuyya). In these prose passages it takes a direct object in the accusative (uppādaṃ, pavattaṃ, nimittaṃ) and means 'having gone beyond'. Root base is omitted because the form is a secondary derivation.

dvattiṃsatimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal from dvattiṃsa (32). Nominative singular modifying niddeso in the text.

pariyogāhaṇañāṇaniddeso.meaning_2: detailed explanation of knowledge as fathoming; exposition of the knowledge of full understanding
pariyogāhaṇañāṇaniddeso.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Title of the 42nd chapter of the Paṭisambhidāmagga. Nominative singular in the text. pariyogāhaṇa is itself a compound (pari + ogāhaṇa, from √gāh), but the whole is treated as a multi-word compound here.
pariyogāhaṇañāṇaniddeso.translation_2: 42. Detailed explanation of knowledge as fathoming

paridametvā.meaning_2: having tamed; having subdued; having made pliant
paridametvā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Absolutive in -tvā, used in a series with paribhāvetvā and karitvā describing refining the mind. Causative of √dam with pari-.
paridametvā.example_1: so imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṃ paribhāvetvā paridametvā muduṃ karitvā kammaniyaṃ kāyampi citte samodahati, cittampi kāye samodahati, kāyavasena cittaṃ pariṇāmeti, cittavasena kāyaṃ pariṇāmeti, kāyavasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, cittavasena kāyaṃ adhiṭṭhāti;
paridametvā.example_2: so imesu catūsu iddhipādesu cittaṃ paribhāvetvā paridametvā, muduṃ karitvā kammaniyaṃ dūrepi saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, santikepi saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, oḷārikānampi saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, sukhumānampi saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, saṇhasaṇhānampi saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, puratthimāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, pacchimāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, uttarāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, dakkhiṇāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, puratthimāyapi anudisāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, pacchimāyapi anudisāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, uttarāyapi anudisāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, dakkhiṇāyapi anudisāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, heṭṭhimāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti, uparimāyapi disāya saddānaṃ saddanimittaṃ manasi karoti.

tesaṭṭhimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal made from tesaṭṭhi (63) with the suffix -ma. In the text it is used as a section number, nominative singular. Sometimes written tesaṭṭhimo with the nominative ending.

sattasaṭṭhimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Numbered section heading in the Paṭisambhidāmagga; nominative singular agreeing with niddeso.

aṭṭhasaṭṭhimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal of aṭṭhasaṭṭhi (68); section heading meaning 'the sixty-eighth' (niddesa). Nominative singular in the text.

navasaṭṭhimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal from nava + saṭṭhi, used as the heading number of the section; nominative singular in the text.

sattatimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal formed from sattati with the suffix -ma. Nominative singular masculine here, agreeing with niddeso at the end of the section title.

gulāguṇḍikajāto.meaning_2: become a tangled ball; become a matted web
gulāguṇḍikajāto.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Variant spelling found in the Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī and Sīhalaṭṭhakathā as cited in the text; the main reading is guḷāguṇṭhikajāta. Nominative singular qualifying lokasannivāso.
gulāguṇḍikajāto.example_1: tassa natthañño koci ālokaṃ dassetā, aññatra mayāti – passantānaṃ … pe … avijjāgato lokasannivāso aṇḍabhūto pariyonaddho tantākulakajāto [tantākulajāto (syā.)] kulāgaṇḍikajāto [guḷāguṇṭhikajāto (syā.), gulāguṇḍikajāto (ka. sī. aṭṭha.) dī. ni.2.95 passitabbā] muñjapabbajabhūto apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattatīti – passantānaṃ … pe … avijjāvisadosasaṃlitto lokasannivāso kilesakalalībhūtoti – passantānaṃ … pe … rāgadosamohajaṭājaṭito lokasannivāso;
gulāguṇḍikajāto.translation_1: apart from me, there is no one else to show the light;” ... “The world as an abode is overcome by ignorance, an egg-shell, and is surrounded; it is like a tangled skein, like a matted web of thread, like matted rushes and reeds; it does not escape from the state of deprivation, the bad destination, perdition, and saṃsāra;” ... “The world as an abode is smeared with the fault of the poison of ignorance; it has become a mire of defilements;” ... “The world as an abode is tangled in the tangle of lust, hatred, and delusion;

ekasattatimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Nominative singular qualifying niddesa in the text.

tesattatimo.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ordinal from tesattati (seventy-three); here masculine nominative singular in a section title.
tesattatimo.translation_1: The seventy-third section: explanation of omniscient knowledge is finished.

aṭṭhārasamī.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Feminine form agreeing with diṭṭhi, modifying it in the text (nominative singular).

uducittaṃ.meaning_2: with a straight mind; with an upright mind; mentally upright
uducittaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Accusative singular in the text, qualifying cittaṃ. udu = straight, upright; citta = mind.
uducittaṃ.example_1: 153. Imehi soḷasahi ākārehi uducittaṃ cittaṃ samuducitaṃ cittaṃ ekatte santiṭṭhati, nīvaraṇehi visujjhati.
uducittaṃ.translation_1: 153. Through these sixteen aspects, the mind that is oriented and well oriented becomes steadied in oneness and is purified from the hindrances.

ānanti.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] The text form ānanti is likely a variant or error for ānandaṃ (accusative singular) or the adjective ānandī (joyful), which shares the same sense. The word means 'joy', 'delight', and in technical contexts 'rapture' as a factor of jhāna.

ānamanā.meaning_2: bending; bending forward; bending down; inclination
ānamanā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] ānamati is itself a secondary derivative of namati; the PEU analysis Ā+namu+yu is doubtful. Part of a stock list of bodily movements (ānamanā vinamanā ... pakampanā). Nominative singular in the text.
ānamanā.example_1: yathārūpehi kāyasaṅkhārehi yā kāyassa ānamanā vinamanā sannamanā paṇamanā iñjanā phandanā calanā pakampanā—
ānamanā.example_2: yathārūpehi kāyasaṅkhārehi yā kāyassa na ānamanā na vinamanā na sannamanā na paṇamanā aniñjanā aphandanā acalanā akampanā santaṃ sukhumaṃ passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.

samādhindiyaṃ.meaning_2: faculty of concentration; concentration as a faculty
samādhindiyaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Compound of samādhi + indiya; variant reading samādhindiyaṃ for samādhi. The -i- of indiya is elided after samādhi. Neuter nominative singular in the text.

adhiṭṭiti.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Variant reading (syā.) in a list of concentration terms, equivalent to avaṭṭhiti; nominative singular in the text.
adhiṭṭiti.example_1: Dīghaṃ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggatā avikkhepo samādhi, yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti [adhiṭṭiti (syā.)] avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā [avisāhatamānasatā (syā. ka.)] samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi.
adhiṭṭiti.translation_1: One-pointedness and non-distraction of the mind through long in-breaths are concentration. Any stationariness, steadiedness, steadfastness, non-scattering, non-distraction, non-scatteredness of mentation, tranquility, concentration faculty, concentration power, or right concentration of the mind—this is concentration.

dukkhānupassanāvase.meaning_2: by way of contemplation of suffering; in the aspect of observing suffering
dukkhānupassanāvase.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Locative singular in the text, parallel to the following -vasena forms. Compound of dukkha, anupassanā and vasa (control; way, aspect).
dukkhānupassanāvase.example_1: Aniccānupassanā pañcahindriyehi dukkhānupassanāvase pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, dukkhānupassanā pañcahindriyehi anattānupassanāvase pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, anattānupassanā pañcahindriyehi nibbidānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nibbidānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi virāgānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, virāgānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi nirodhānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nirodhānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi paṭinissaggānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, paṭinissaggānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi khayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, khayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vipariṇāmānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vipariṇāmānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi animittānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, animittānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi appaṇihitānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, appaṇihitānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi suññatānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti suññatānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi adhipaññādhammavipassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.
dukkhānupassanāvase.translation_1: The five faculties in the contemplation of impermanence have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of suffering; the five faculties in the contemplation of suffering have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of not-self; the five faculties in the contemplation of not-self have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of disenchantment; the five faculties in the contemplation of disenchantment have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of fading away; the five faculties in the contemplation of fading away have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of cessation; the five faculties in the contemplation of cessation have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of relinquishment; the five faculties in the contemplation of relinquishment have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of destruction; the five faculties in the contemplation of destruction have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of fall; the five faculties in the contemplation of fall have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of change; the five faculties in the contemplation of change have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of the signless; the five faculties in the contemplation of the signless have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of the desireless; the five faculties in the contemplation of the desireless have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of voidness; the five faculties in the contemplation of voidness have escaped by way of the five faculties in the higher wisdom of insight into phenomena.

anattānupassanāvase.meaning_2: power of the contemplation of not-self; by way of the contemplation of not-self; benefit of insight into non-self
anattānupassanāvase.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] In the text the form is the locative singular anattānupassanāvase, used in the phrase anattānupassanāvase ... nissaṭāni honti, 'are released by way of the contemplation of not-self'. The compound can be analysed as anattā + anupassanā + vasa, or with anupassanāvasa as the final member.
anattānupassanāvase.example_1: Aniccānupassanā pañcahindriyehi dukkhānupassanāvase pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, dukkhānupassanā pañcahindriyehi anattānupassanāvase pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, anattānupassanā pañcahindriyehi nibbidānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nibbidānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi virāgānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, virāgānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi nirodhānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, nirodhānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi paṭinissaggānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, paṭinissaggānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi khayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, khayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vayānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vayānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi vipariṇāmānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, vipariṇāmānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi animittānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, animittānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi appaṇihitānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti, appaṇihitānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi suññatānupassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti suññatānupassanāya pañcahindriyehi adhipaññādhammavipassanāvasena pañcindriyāni nissaṭāni honti.
anattānupassanāvase.translation_1: The five faculties in the contemplation of impermanence have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of suffering; the five faculties in the contemplation of suffering have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of not-self; the five faculties in the contemplation of not-self have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of disenchantment; the five faculties in the contemplation of disenchantment have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of fading away; the five faculties in the contemplation of fading away have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of cessation; the five faculties in the contemplation of cessation have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of relinquishment; the five faculties in the contemplation of relinquishment have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of destruction; the five faculties in the contemplation of destruction have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of fall; the five faculties in the contemplation of fall have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of change; the five faculties in the contemplation of change have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of the signless; the five faculties in the contemplation of the signless have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of the desireless; the five faculties in the contemplation of the desireless have escaped by way of the five faculties in the contemplation of voidness; the five faculties in the contemplation of voidness have escaped by way of the five faculties in the higher wisdom of insight into phenomena.

vosajjitattā.meaning_2: state of having been relinquished; condition of being let go
vosajjitattā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Ablative singular in the text (vosajjitattā). Probably vosajjita (pp of vosajjati, 'relinquished') + -tta, meaning 'the state of being relinquished'; alternative analysis as a compound with vosajjiya (gerundive) + -tta.
vosajjitattā.example_2: Vosajjitattā tato nirujjhanti – nirodhavasena saddhāvasena saddhindriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti.
vosajjitattā.translation_2: Because of having been relinquished, they therefore cease; through cessation and through faith, the faith faculty is outstanding.

avatthāpetvā.meaning_2: having established; having stabilised; having fixed firmly
avatthāpetvā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] In the text preceded by svāvatthitaṃ; the phrase means 'having made it well established'. Causative absolutive of avatthāpeti, related to avatthita.
avatthāpetvā.example_1: so taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā sūpadhāritaṃ upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṃ avatthāpetvā bahiddhā nīlanimitte cittaṃ upasaṃharati, nīlasaññaṃ paṭilabhati.
avatthāpetvā.example_2: so taṃ nimittaṃ suggahitaṃ katvā upadhāretvā svāvatthitaṃ avatthāpetvā āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

aniccānupassanāñāṃ.meaning_2: knowledge of contemplation of impermanence; insight into impermanence
aniccānupassanāñāṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Nominative singular in the text, written with ṃ before niccato; part of the compound aniccānupassanāñāṇa.
aniccānupassanāñāṃ.translation_1: Knowledge of contemplation of impermanence is liberated from perception as permanent—thus it is liberation of perception.

dukkhānupassanāñāṃ.meaning_2: knowledge of contemplation of suffering; insight knowledge observing suffering
dukkhānupassanāñāṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Written dukkhānupassanāñāṃ in the text, with the final -ṃ representing the niggahīta of the nominative singular (sandhi/by-form of dukkhānupassanāñāṇaṃ).
dukkhānupassanāñāṃ.translation_1: Knowledge of contemplation of suffering is liberated from perception as pleasant—thus it is liberation of perception.

thābhūtaṃ.meaning_2: being so; being in that state; thus-conditioned
thābhūtaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Doubtful and rare; only occurrence in this text. Accusative singular modifying ñāṇaṃ; possibly thā (thus, so) + bhūta, but the exact sandhi and sense are uncertain.
thābhūtaṃ.example_1: Appaṇihitānupassanā thābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṇidhiyā sammohā aññāṇā muccatīti – ñāṇavimokkho.
thābhūtaṃ.translation_1: Correct knowledge as contemplation of the desireless is liberated from unknowing as confusion about desire—thus it is liberation of knowledge.

paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena.meaning_2: in the sense of being conducive to awakening; by way of the meaning of the factors partaking of awakening
paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Instrumental case form of paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭha, used adverbially in a list of four parallel phrases (bodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena, anubodhi-, paṭibodhi-, sambodhi-). The PSK reading paṭibodhi may be a textual variant for sambodhi.
paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena.example_1: bodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, anubodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, sambodhipakkhiyaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena.meaning_2: state of leading to wisdom; condition of elevating wisdom
buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Instrumental singular used in a definition of the bojjhaṅgas. The compound means the state of leading to or elevating wisdom; cf. buddhiropanaṭṭhena in the same passage. Variant reading buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena.
buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena.example_1: buddhilabhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhipaṭilabhanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhiropanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhiabhiropanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhipāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā, buddhisampāpanaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā.

paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhaṃ.meaning_2: meaning of the factors of awakening; sense of the requisites of enlightenment
paṭibodhipakkhiyaṭṭhaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Paṭibodhi is likely paṭi + bodhi (enlightenment); the compound with attha is glossed in the Paṭisambhidāmagga as the meaning of bojjhaṅga. Accusative singular in the text.

paṭijotanaṭṭhaṃ.meaning_2: state of illuminating; sense of making bright; meaning of lighting up
paṭijotanaṭṭhaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Looks like paṭijotana + aṭṭha (from attha), though the shortening of the final -a before the suffix is irregular; possibly a misreading for paṭijotanatthaṃ. Accusative singular in the text, glossing bojjhaṅga.

svālaṅkatā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Feminine nominative singular svālaṅkatā agreeing with mettācetovimutti. Su + alaṅkata with elision of the following a. The commentary glosses suṭṭhu alaṅkatā bhūsitā.
svālaṅkatā.example_1: imehi pañcahi indriyehi mettācetovimutti svālaṅkatā hoti.
svālaṅkatā.example_2: imehi pañcahi balehi mettācetovimutti svālaṅkatā hoti.

saṃdhūpentīti.meaning_2: does not stoke up; does not heat; does not inflame
saṃdhūpentīti.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] In 'saṃdhūpentīti' the verb is saṃdhūpeti with the quotation -ti and the sandhi -tī-ti. Negative in the text: 'na saṃdhūpentīti'. Could also be analysed as a denominative in -peti; the causative of √dhū is the closest match.
saṃdhūpentīti.translation_1: They do not stoke up the world, thus they are supramundane.

adhigatappaṭisambhido.meaning_2: who has attained the analytical knowledges; having mastered the discriminations
adhigatappaṭisambhido.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] A bahubbīhi compound describing the Buddha; nominative singular in the text, agreeing with pabhinnañāṇo etc. adhigata is a past participle of adhigacchati, paṭisambhida is feminine.
adhigatappaṭisambhido.example_1: paññāpabhedakusalo pabhinnañāṇo adhigatappaṭisambhido catuvesārajjappatto dasabaladhārī purisāsabho purisasīho purisanāgo purisājañño purisadhorayho anantañāṇo anantatejo anantayaso aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavā netā vinetā anunetā paññāpetā nijjhāpetā pekkhetā pasādetā.

parijappetvā.meaning_2: having muttered; having recited; having chanted
parijappetvā.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Absolutive in -tvā of parijappeti; the text has parijappetvā (cf. Sanskrit paryalpya). Could also be analysed as a causative of √japp with pari-.
parijappetvā.example_1: vijjādharā vijjaṃ parijappetvā vehāsaṃ gacchanti, ākāse antalikkhe hatthimpi dassenti, assampi dassenti, rathampi dassenti, pattimpi dassenti, vividhampi senābyūhaṃ dassenti.

syāyaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Variant reading (syā. pī.) for yvāyaṃ (yo + ayaṃ); sandhi of so + ayaṃ with the same sense, nominative singular referring to the person.
syāyaṃ.example_1: Yvāyaṃ [syāyaṃ (syā. pī.)] kilese pajahati, atīte kilese pajahati … pe … anāgate kilese pajahati, paccuppanne kilese pajahati, atīte kilese pajahatīti.
syāyaṃ.translation_1: As for the individual who abandons defilements, does he abandon past defilements, ... abandon future defilements, or abandon presently-arisen defilements? He abandons past defilements.

pāṭihāri.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Shortened/abbreviated form of pāṭihāriya in the verse; may alternatively be analysed as pāṭihāri(ya).
pāṭihāri.translation_2: miracles, same-headedness, ways of attending to mindfulness, insight;

pariyogāhaṇañāṇaniddesa.meaning_2: exposition of the knowledge of penetrating; explanation of the knowledge of full understanding
pariyogāhaṇañāṇaniddesa.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Title of a section of the Paṭisambhidāmagga. Nominative singular in the text.

uducitaṃ.meaning_2: straightly accumulated; properly cultivated; raised up straight
uducitaṃ.comment: [deepseek: deepseek-v4-flash] Accusative singular neuter agreeing with cittaṃ. Formed with udu (straight) + cita (collected, accumulated), perhaps partly influenced by uju; the PEU guide instead analyses it as udu + ucita. Pakati-saddatā uncertain.
uducitaṃ.example_1: imehi soḷasahi ākārehi uducitaṃ cittaṃ samuducitaṃ cittaṃ ekatte santiṭṭhati, nīvaraṇehi visujjhati.
